Take Out and Refill Pop Up

Pop Up Mob transformed NYC's iconic Papaya Dog into a Gisou takeout and refill pop-up, reimagining the classic hot dog stand as a honey-infused beauty counter where guests could refill their favorite haircare products and experience the brand in a distinctly New York setting.
